transformations.source:
INPUT List, Target

    Found <- FALSE

    FOR i <- 0 TO LENGTH(List)-1
        IF List[i] == Target THEN
            OUTPUT "Found at position", i
            Found <- TRUE
            EXIT FOR
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR

    IF Found == FALSE THEN
        OUTPUT "Target not found"
    ENDIF
END
transformations.canonical:
FUNCTION unnamed_function ACCEPTS(List, Target)
    Found <- BOOLEAN(False)

    FOR i <- IN RANGE 0 TO (LENGTH OF List - 1) + 1 DO
        IF List[i] == Target THEN
            OUTPUT STRING("Found at position {i}")
            Found <- BOOLEAN(True)
            BREAK
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR

    IF Found == BOOLEAN(False) THEN
        OUTPUT STRING("Target not found")
    ENDIF
ENDFUNCTION
